facts.business: Salora International Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of consumer durable products including Smart LED TVs, washing machines, coolers, audio accessories, TWS earbuds, headphones, smartwatches, mobile phones, and mobile accessories.

auditor.name: O P BAGLA & CO. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: 1) Pending SLP in Supreme Court and writ petition in Delhi High Court regarding disputed excise matters of Rs. 2435.21 lakhs plus penalty for FY 1993-94 to 2003-04, with contingent liability of Rs. 4870.42 lakhs. 2) Material statutory dues recoverable of Sales tax Rs. 366.90 lakhs and Income tax Rs. 203.46 lakhs considered good pending final assessment, and old material of Rs. 71.49 lakhs with third party subject to confirmation. 3) Deferred tax assets of Rs. 2038.78 lakhs (including Rs. 984.26 lakhs on unabsorbed business losses) expected to be realized based on enhanced product portfolio and new business strategy.

key_risks: Increased competition and product options with multi-national participants entering the market leading to pricing pressure
Consumer Electronics industry dependent on multiple market factors especially change in technology in India which may impact demand
Industry volatilities and rising prices remain a threat
